mapper.select: select project_id, state, from_commit, current_commit, changed, started_at, finished_at, failure_reason from builder.adk_builder_repository_update where project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_repository_update (project_id, state, started_at, finished_at, failure_reason) values (#{projectId}, 'RUNNING', now(), null, null) on conflict (project_id) do update set state = 'RUNNING', started_at = now(), finished_at = null, failure_reason = null where builder.adk_builder_repository_update.state <> 'RUNNING'
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_repository_update set state = 'SUCCEEDED', from_commit = #{fromCommit}, current_commit = #{currentCommit}, changed = #{changed}, finished_at = now(), failure_reason = null where project_id = #{projectId} and state = 'RUNNING'
